skippedTests.fullName: Shared useSyncExternalStore behavior (shim and built-in) compares to current state before bailing out, even when there's a mutation in between the sync and passive effects
skippedTests.rationale: React gates this case with `@gate enableUseSyncExternalStoreShim`: it observes a legacy root between a synchronous render and its passive effects, which only the React 17 shim variant can do. The build-test configuration on React 18+ does not run it.
